nodes.name: canvas_state.rs
nodes.summary: Core canvas state manager handling drawing operations, image loading, text rendering, path management, and 2D context state for the HTML canvas implementation.
nodes.languageNotes: Large Rust implementation with extensive trait and method-based design for Canvas2D API.

nodes.name: CanvasFillOrStrokeStyle
nodes.summary: Enumeration for canvas fill/stroke style variants supporting solid colors, linear/radial gradients, and image patterns.

nodes.name: CanvasContextState
nodes.summary: Represents a snapshot of the 2D canvas rendering state including transform, fill/stroke styles, shadows, line styles, text settings, and compositing options.

nodes.name: CanvasState
nodes.summary: Central state holder for the 2D canvas context, managing rendering state (transform, styles, shadows, clipping) and dispatching draw commands to the paint thread.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a default CanvasContextState with initial identity transform and default styles.

nodes.name: line_options
nodes.summary: Builds a LineOptions struct from the current canvas state for paint thread commands.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new CanvasState with canvas dimensions, paint thread channel, image cache, and initial drawing state.

nodes.name: set_image_key
nodes.summary: Sets the image key on the canvas state for paint thread communication.

nodes.name: send_canvas_command
nodes.summary: Sends a canvas command to the paint thread via the buffered sender, if paintable.

nodes.name: send_canvas_command_immediate
nodes.summary: Sends a canvas command immediately (flushing buffer) to the paint thread if paintable.

nodes.name: update_rendering
nodes.summary: Initiates a rendering update by sending the current canvas image to the paint thread.

nodes.name: set_bitmap_dimensions
nodes.summary: Updates the canvas bitmap dimensions, resetting state and recreating the paint thread bitmap.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Resets the canvas state to initial values and reinitializes the underlying bitmap.

nodes.name: reset_to_initial_state
nodes.summary: Restores all canvas state fields to their default values without recreating the bitmap.

nodes.name: reset_bitmap
nodes.summary: Clears the canvas bitmap to transparent and resets the transform to identity.

nodes.name: create_drawable_rect
nodes.summary: Validates and creates a drawable rectangle from coordinates, returning None if any dimension is non-finite.

nodes.name: is_origin_clean
nodes.summary: Checks whether an image source has the same origin as the canvas to determine taint status.

nodes.name: fetch_image_data
nodes.summary: Retrieves image data from cache or fetch, returning a raster snapshot for drawing.

nodes.name: request_image_from_cache
nodes.summary: Requests an image from the image cache by URL and cors setting, tracking missing URLs.

nodes.name: draw_image_internal
nodes.summary: Routes image drawing to the appropriate handler based on image type (HTML, video, canvas, bitmap, SVG).

nodes.name: draw_html_image_element
nodes.summary: Draws an HTML image element onto the canvas with source/dest rect adjustment and shadow/composition options.

nodes.name: draw_html_video_element
nodes.summary: Draws the current frame of a video element onto the canvas with proper rect adjustment.

nodes.name: draw_offscreen_canvas
nodes.summary: Draws an OffscreenCanvas onto the canvas, handling both in-process and cross-canvas rendering via paint thread commands.

nodes.name: draw_html_canvas_element
nodes.summary: Draws an HTMLCanvasElement onto the canvas, extracting image data from the source canvas context.

nodes.name: fetch_and_draw_image_data
nodes.summary: Fetches an image from a URL and draws it onto the canvas, coordinating async image loading.

nodes.name: draw_image_bitmap
nodes.summary: Draws an ImageBitmap onto the canvas with source and destination rectangle adjustment.

nodes.name: mark_as_dirty
nodes.summary: Marks the canvas element as dirty to trigger a repaint.

nodes.name: adjust_source_dest_rects
nodes.summary: Adjusts source and destination rectangle dimensions for proper image scaling and clipping.

nodes.name: update_transform
nodes.summary: Updates the canvas transform by multiplying the current transform with a new one.

nodes.name: fill_rect
nodes.summary: Fills a rectangle on the canvas using the current fill style.

nodes.name: clear_rect
nodes.summary: Clears a rectangle region on the canvas to transparent.

nodes.name: stroke_rect
nodes.summary: Strokes a rectangle outline on the canvas using the current stroke style.

nodes.name: set_shadow_offset_x
nodes.summary: Sets the horizontal shadow offset with bounds clamping.

nodes.name: set_shadow_offset_y
nodes.summary: Sets the vertical shadow offset with bounds clamping.

nodes.name: set_shadow_blur
nodes.summary: Sets the shadow blur radius, clamped to non-negative values.

nodes.name: shadow_color
nodes.summary: Returns the current shadow color.

nodes.name: set_shadow_color
nodes.summary: Parses and sets the shadow color from a CSS color string.

nodes.name: stroke_style
nodes.summary: Returns the current stroke style as a DOM-compatible color or gradient/pattern string.

nodes.name: set_stroke_style
nodes.summary: Parses and sets the stroke style from a DOM color string, gradient, or pattern.

nodes.name: fill_style
nodes.summary: Returns the current fill style as a DOM-compatible color or gradient/pattern string.

nodes.name: set_fill_style
nodes.summary: Parses and sets the fill style from a DOM color string, gradient, or pattern.

nodes.name: create_linear_gradient
nodes.summary: Creates a new linear gradient with specified start and end coordinates.

nodes.name: create_radial_gradient
nodes.summary: Creates a new radial gradient with specified start and end circles.

nodes.name: create_pattern
nodes.summary: Creates a canvas pattern from an image source with specified repetition mode.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Saves the current canvas state onto the state stack for later restoration.

nodes.name: restore
nodes.summary: Restores the canvas state from the top of the saved state stack.

nodes.name: set_global_alpha
nodes.summary: Sets the global alpha value.

nodes.name: global_composite_operation
nodes.summary: Returns the current global composite operation identifier.

nodes.name: set_global_composite_operation
nodes.summary: Sets the global composite operation from a string value.

nodes.name: set_image_smoothing_enabled
nodes.summary: Enables or disables image smoothing for scaled image drawing.

nodes.name: fill_text
nodes.summary: Renders filled text at the specified position using the current font and fill style.

nodes.name: stroke_text
nodes.summary: Renders stroked text outlines at the specified position using the current font and stroke style.

nodes.name: measure_text
nodes.summary: Measures text dimensions using the current font and returns a TextMetrics object with width and baseline data.

nodes.name: set_font
nodes.summary: Parses and sets the font from a CSS font shorthand string.

nodes.name: font
nodes.summary: Returns the current font as a CSS font shorthand string.

nodes.name: set_text_align
nodes.summary: CanvasState method for set text align.

nodes.name: set_text_baseline
nodes.summary: CanvasState method for set text baseline.

nodes.name: set_direction
nodes.summary: CanvasState method for set direction.

nodes.name: set_line_width
nodes.summary: Sets the line width, clamped to non-negative values.

nodes.name: line_cap
nodes.summary: Returns the current line cap style.

nodes.name: set_line_cap
nodes.summary: Sets the line cap style (butt, round, or square).

nodes.name: line_join
nodes.summary: Returns the current line join style.

nodes.name: set_line_join
nodes.summary: Sets the line join style (round, bevel, or miter).

nodes.name: set_miter_limit
nodes.summary: Sets the miter limit, clamped to non-negative values.

nodes.name: line_dash
nodes.summary: Returns the current line dash pattern as an array.

nodes.name: set_line_dash
nodes.summary: Sets the line dash pattern from an array of segment lengths.

nodes.name: line_dash_offset
nodes.summary: Returns the current line dash offset.

nodes.name: set_line_dash_offset
nodes.summary: Sets the line dash offset with bounds clamping.

nodes.name: create_image_data
nodes.summary: Creates a new ImageData object with specified dimensions.

nodes.name: create_image_data_
nodes.summary: Creates an ImageData object from an existing ImageData.

nodes.name: get_image_data
nodes.summary: Extracts pixel data from the canvas region as an ImageData object, respecting origin-clean taint checks.

nodes.name: put_image_data
nodes.summary: Writes ImageData pixel data onto the canvas at specified coordinates.

nodes.name: put_image_data_
nodes.summary: Writes a dirty rectangle of ImageData onto the canvas with clipping to canvas bounds.

nodes.name: draw_image
nodes.summary: Draws an image onto the canvas (1-argument variant) with automatic source type dispatch.

nodes.name: draw_image_
nodes.summary: Draws an image onto the canvas (3-argument variant) with source type dispatch.

nodes.name: draw_image__
nodes.summary: Draws an image onto the canvas (5-argument variant) with source and destination rects.

nodes.name: begin_path
nodes.summary: Begins a new path by clearing the current path.

nodes.name: fill
nodes.summary: Fills the current path using the current fill style.

nodes.name: fill_
nodes.summary: Fills a specified Path2D object using the current fill style.

nodes.name: stroke
nodes.summary: Strokes the current path using the current stroke style.

nodes.name: stroke_
nodes.summary: Strokes a specified Path2D object using the current stroke style.

nodes.name: clip
nodes.summary: Creates a clipping region from the current path.

nodes.name: clip_
nodes.summary: Creates a clipping region from a specified Path2D object.

nodes.name: is_point_in_path
nodes.summary: Tests whether a point is inside the current path using the specified fill rule.

nodes.name: is_point_in_path_
nodes.summary: Tests whether a point is inside a specified Path2D object using the given fill rule.

nodes.name: scale
nodes.summary: Applies a scale transformation to the canvas coordinate system.

nodes.name: rotate
nodes.summary: Applies a rotation transformation to the canvas coordinate system.

nodes.name: translate
nodes.summary: Applies a translation transformation to the canvas coordinate system.

nodes.name: transform
nodes.summary: Multiplies the current transform by a general 2D affine transformation matrix.

nodes.name: get_transform
nodes.summary: Returns a DOMMatrix representing the current canvas transform.

nodes.name: set_transform
nodes.summary: Replaces the canvas transform with a new affine transformation matrix defined by individual components.

nodes.name: set_transform_
nodes.summary: Replaces the canvas transform with a given Transform2D matrix.

nodes.name: reset_transform
nodes.summary: Resets the canvas transform to the identity matrix.

nodes.name: close_path
nodes.summary: Closes the current sub-path by adding a line back to the start.

nodes.name: move_to
nodes.summary: Moves the path cursor to a new coordinate without drawing.

nodes.name: line_to
nodes.summary: Adds a straight line from the current position to the specified coordinate.

nodes.name: rect
nodes.summary: Adds a rectangle sub-path to the current path.

nodes.name: quadratic_curve_to
nodes.summary: Adds a quadratic bezier curve sub-path to the current path.

nodes.name: bezier_curve_to
nodes.summary: Adds a cubic bezier curve sub-path to the current path.

nodes.name: arc
nodes.summary: Adds an arc sub-path to the current path.

nodes.name: arc_to
nodes.summary: Adds an arc-to sub-path connecting two points with a given radius.

nodes.name: ellipse
nodes.summary: Adds an elliptical arc sub-path to the current path.

nodes.name: text_with_size
nodes.summary: Renders text at a specified size with optional max-width constraint, handling anchor points and alignment.

nodes.name: build_unshaped_text_runs
nodes.summary: Builds unshaped text runs from a text string, splitting by font and script boundaries.

nodes.name: find_anchor_point_for_line_of_text
nodes.summary: Calculates the anchor point for text positioning based on text alignment and baseline settings.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: CanvasState method for new.

nodes.name: script_and_font_compatible
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given script is compatible with a font for text shaping.

nodes.name: into_shaped_text_run
nodes.summary: Converts an unshaped text run into a shaped text run by applying font shaping and measuring glyph advances.

nodes.name: parse_color
nodes.summary: Parses a CSS color string into a canvas-compatible RGBA color value.

nodes.name: is_rect_valid
nodes.summary: CanvasState method for is rect valid.

nodes.name: serialize
nodes.summary: Serializes a canvas color value into a CSS color string for DOM consumption.

nodes.name: adjust_size_sign
nodes.summary: Adjusts rectangle origin and size to ensure positive width and height.

nodes.name: serialize_font
nodes.summary: Serializes font style properties into a CSS font shorthand string.

nodes.name: adjust_canvas_size
nodes.summary: Clamps canvas dimensions to WebGL maximum size limits.

nodes.name: canvasgradient.rs
nodes.summary: Defines CanvasGradient types supporting linear and radial gradient creation with color stop management for the 2D canvas API.

nodes.name: CanvasGradient
nodes.summary: DOM representation of a canvas gradient with color stops, supporting addColorStop() for gradient definition.

nodes.name: CanvasGradientStyle
nodes.summary: Internal gradient data storage containing color stop definitions used to construct Webrender gradient displays.

nodes.name: ToFillOrStrokeStyle
nodes.summary: Trait for converting gradient and pattern types into the internal FillOrStrokeStyle representation used by the paint thread.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new CanvasGradient with given color stop initialization for linear or radial gradients.

nodes.name: AddColorStop
nodes.summary: Adds a color stop at the specified offset to the gradient definition.

nodes.name: to_fill_or_stroke_style
nodes.summary: Converts gradient data into the internal FillOrStrokeStyle for paint thread consumption.

nodes.name: canvaspattern.rs
nodes.summary: Implements CanvasPattern for repeating image patterns used as fill and stroke styles in the 2D canvas context.

nodes.name: CanvasPattern
nodes.summary: DOM representation of a canvas pattern with image source, repetition mode, and transform support for use as fill/stroke styles.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Creates a new CanvasPattern with inherited DOM bindings from image source and repetition mode.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public constructor for CanvasPattern that initializes the pattern with image data and repetition type.

nodes.name: SetTransform
nodes.summary: Sets a transform matrix on the pattern for affine transformations during rendering.
